pr.title: gh-143308: fix UAF when PickleBuffer is concurrently mutated in a callback
pr.body:
This PR addresses a use-after-free vulnerability in `save_picklebuffer` in `Modules/_pickle.c`. The issue occurred when a buffer_callback explicitly released the PickleBuffer while the pickler was still serializing it.

Validation

- New Tests: Added `test_release_in_callback_keepalive` and `test_release_in_callback_complex_keepalive` to `Lib/test/test_pickle.py`. 

Linked issue: gh-128038

<!-- gh-issue-number: gh-143308 -->
* Issue: gh-143308
<!-- /gh-issue-number -->

+    def do_test_concurrent_mutation_in_buffer_callback(self, factory):
+        # See: https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/143308.
+        class R:
+            def __bool__(self):
+                buf.release()
+                return True

+        for proto in range(5, pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL + 1):
+            obj, sub = factory()
+            buf = pickle.PickleBuffer(obj)
+            buffer_callback = lambda _: R()
+
+            with self.subTest(proto=proto, obj=obj, sub=sub):
+                res = self.dumps(buf, proto, buffer_callback=buffer_callback)
+                self.assertIn(sub, res)
+

+:mod:`pickle`: fix use-after-free crashes when a :class:`~pickle.PickleBuffer`
+is concurrently mutated by a custom buffer callback during pickling.
+Patch by Bénédikt Tran and Aaron Wieczorek.

review_comments.body:
If we ever add protocol 6, the test will fail. You'll need something like that.

```py
def test_concurrent_mutation_in_buffer_with_bytearray(self):
    def factory():
        s = b"a" * 16
        return bytearray(s), s

    self.do_test_concurrent_mutation_in_buffer_callback(factory)

def test_concurrent_mutation_in_buffer_with_memoryview(self):
    def factory():
        c, n = b"a", 64
        sub = c*(n//2)
        obj = memoryview(bytearray(c*n))[n//4:3*n//4]
        return obj, sub

    self.do_test_concurrent_mutation_in_buffer_callback(factory)

def do_test_concurrent_mutation_in_buffer_callback(self, factory):
    class R:
        def __bool__(self):
            buf.release()
            return True

    for proto in range(5, pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL + 1):
        obj, sub = factory()
        buf = pickle.PickleBuffer(obj)
        buffer_callback = lambda _: R()

        with self.subTest(proto=proto, obj=obj, sub=sub):
            res = self.dumps(pb, proto, buffer_callback=buffer_callback)
            self.assertIn(sub, res)
```
